INSERT INTO rulesDatabase (ruleCode, codeVersion, jurisdiction, title, description, category, nbcReference, ruleData, isActive, effectiveDate, createdBy, version) VALUES
('ACC-001', 'NBC_2025', 'Canada', 'Accessible Entrance Requirements', 'At least one accessible entrance required for all public buildings.', 'ACCESSIBILITY', 'NBC 3.8.1.1', '{"minWidth":1.0,"maxSlope":0.05,"levelLanding":true}', true, NOW(), 1, 1),
('ACC-002', 'NBC_2025', 'Canada', 'Accessible Washroom Requirements', 'Accessible washrooms required in public buildings.', 'ACCESSIBILITY', 'NBC 3.8.2.1', '{"minStallWidth":1.5,"grabBars":true,"accessibleSinks":true}', true, NOW(), 1, 1),
('ACC-003', 'NBC_2025', 'Canada', 'Grab Bar Requirements', 'Grab bars required in accessible washrooms and bathing areas.', 'ACCESSIBILITY', 'NBC 3.8.2.2', '{"diameter":{"min":32,"max":38},"height":850,"spacing":{"min":40,"max":60}}', true, NOW(), 1, 1),
('CONST-001', 'NBC_2025', 'Canada', 'Non-Combustible Construction Requirements', 'Buildings must be constructed of non-combustible materials.', 'CONSTRUCTION', 'NBC 3.1.4.1', '{"fireRating":2,"materials":["steel","concrete","masonry"]}', true, NOW(), 1, 1),
('CONST-002', 'NBC_2025', 'Canada', 'Combustible Construction Limitations', 'Combustible construction permitted only in certain occupancies and sizes.', 'CONSTRUCTION', 'NBC 3.1.4.2', '{"maxHeight":{"residential":4,"commercial":3},"maxArea":{"residential":5000,"commercial":2000},"sprinklersRequired":true}', true, NOW(), 1, 1);
